dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region show a sharp high-contrast boundary. The most prominent annuli exhibit a light-colored perimeter with a high-gradient transition from dark exterior to a bright 4-6 pixel wide ring and back to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, high-intensity white blobs is observed in the posterior-lateral region. These clusters lack internal intensity gradients and appear as concentrated groupings of high-value pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. A cluster of smaller blobs in the posterior region forms an irregular quadrilateral relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast yellow rectangular identification tag is attached to the posterior flipper region.
